_comment: Editable rule config for reclassify.py (RECLASSIFY_SPEC.md §6). Signal lists and templates are DATA, not code: add procedures / angle-phrasings / clean templates here without touching logic. Matching is case-insensitive over a hyphen-normalized blob of principle_id + rule + judgment. No counts, no targets.

recapture_templates.note: the SIGN of {planet} signifies... -> house_domain on the point; NEVER planet_in_sign (no specific sign).

element_violation._note: An `element` record with no concrete element value cannot be reconciled (no fixed element by nature). Route a single-planet significations id ({planet}-element-{trait}) to house_domain on the point; anything relational/multi-factor (comparison, compatibility, conjunction, lord-of-year, an angle, a second point, a house number) to general. Driven by the rule 'factor_type==element and element absent', not a hardcoded id list.

_fixed_subject_guard_note: Records naming a SPECIFIC rising sign (e.g. asc-scorpio-mars-primary-ruler) assert a fixed ascendant. They are NOT general angle-rules and must never be widened to general by route 4 — they stay unclassified (the LLM/owner can later type them `ascendant`). This protects the keystone false-ascendant behavior.
